description: A Modrinth datapack recreating the ancient Greek sanctuary of Delphi (Delfos) — Doric temple terraces, treasuries, and a hillside theatre. On theme it would have been a strong Mediterranean hero candidate.

style_fit.rationale: Declined at the license gate before download: the Modrinth project is All-Rights-Reserved, which ADR-0013 forbids (no NC/ND/unknown/ARR). It would have fit the Mediterranean brief on theme, but licensing is disqualifying and non-negotiable.

license.note: License determined All-Rights-Reserved from the Modrinth project metadata. ADR-0013 forbids ARR/NC/ND/unknown. Recorded to prevent re-scouting; not downloaded, so interior and quality were not assessed (the quality score is a neutral placeholder).
